title: Guava Cultivation: From Planting to Harvesting Techniques
reason: The transcript describes the process of cultivating, caring for, and harvesting guavas, including various techniques and steps.

tasks.task: Describing the propagation methods for guava trees.

subtasks.text: Observe the farmer cutting a segment from the parent tree for the cutting propagation method.
Note the use of air layering as the most common propagation method due to its high success rate.
Highlight the grafting method for crossbreeding superior guava varieties.

tasks.task: Explaining the stages of planting and caring for guava trees.

subtasks.text: Notice the spacing of young guava plants to maximize light and growth space.
Observe the application of organic fertilizers to support the plant's nutrient absorption.
Watch the pruning process where weak, old, diseased, and overcrowded branches are removed.
Follow the topping of the guava tree to control its height and facilitate harvesting.

tasks.task: Describing post-harvest care and handling of guavas.

subtasks.text: Notice the use of specialized bags for protecting the guavas from pests.
Observe the process of harvesting by hand, wearing protective gloves.
Highlight the sorting and quality inspection of harvested guavas.
